phrases.note: Chọn rồi nói lý do. Một lý do.

example.en: I'd pick Postgres because we need joins.
example.vi: Mình chọn Postgres vì cần join.

phrases.note: Luôn có downside. Đừng bán hàng.

example.en: We could also use a key-value store.
example.vi: Cũng có thể dùng key-value store.

phrases.vi: Mình nghiêng về giữ đơn giản

example.en: I'd rather keep it simple for v1.

pattern.title: Pick and name the downside
pattern.pattern: I'd pick X because… The downside is… We could also… I'd rather keep it simple
pattern.explainVi: Chọn một hướng, nói lý do, nói downside, nêu phương án 2. V1 nghiêng đơn giản.

drills.prompt: Nói việc thật hôm nay: I'd pick X because ___
Nói việc thật hôm nay: The downside is ___
Nói việc thật hôm nay: We could also ___
Nói việc thật hôm nay: Trade-off is ___

listen.title: SQL vs NoSQL, nói nhanh

unseen.speaker: A
unseen.en: I'd pick Redis because we need very low latency reads.
unseen.vi: Chọn Redis vì đọc phải rất nhanh.

unseen.speaker: A
unseen.en: The downside is persistence and memory cost.

unseen.speaker: A
unseen.en: We could also put the mapping in DynamoDB.

unseen.speaker: A
unseen.en: Trade-off is consistency vs availability. Redirects can be eventually consistent.
unseen.vi: Trade-off consistency và availability. Redirect eventual được.

unseen.speaker: A
unseen.en: I'd rather keep it simple. Redis plus nightly backup.
unseen.vi: Giữ đơn giản. Redis + backup đêm.

listen.methodVi: Ẩn chữ. Nghe 1–2 lần (video hoặc TTS). Làm task. Mới mở transcript. Shadow 3 lượt: nghe → nói theo → nói một mình.

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.en: SQL or NoSQL for the mapping?

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.en: I'd pick a key-value store because lookups are by key.
dialogue.vi: Mình chọn KV vì lookup theo key.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.en: The downside is we lose ad-hoc queries.
dialogue.vi: Nhược điểm là mất query linh tinh.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.en: We could also use Postgres with an index on the short key.
dialogue.vi: Cũng có thể Postgres + index short key.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.en: Trade-off is query flexibility vs simple lookups.
dialogue.vi: Trade-off: query linh hoạt với lookup đơn giản.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.en: I'd rather keep it simple for v1.

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.en: Why not both on day one?
dialogue.vi: Sao không cả hai ngày đầu?

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.en: Ops cost. One store until we need analytics.
dialogue.vi: Chi phí ops. Một store đến khi cần analytics.

exercises.prompt: Nói việc thật hôm nay: I'd pick X because ___
Nói việc thật hôm nay: The downside is ___

aiPrompt.scenario: Force one real trade-off (SQL vs KV, or cache vs source of truth). They must name a downside.
aiPrompt.system: You are a software interviewer at a foreign company. Speak natural interview English. Keep each turn to 1–2 short sentences. You MAY use extra interview English so the learner practices listening. Interrupt with a follow-up. Nudge the learner to use these phrases: I'd pick X because…; The downside is…; We could also…; Trade-off is…; I'd rather keep it simple. Ask about their real experience. Wait for the learner to reply. Scenario: Force one real trade-off (SQL vs KV, or cache vs source of truth). They must name a downside.
